title: review-route output
description:
One routing directive emitted by `plan_ops.py review-route`. Every Phase D cell from SKILL.md §§D.2 / D.2a / D.2a.5 / D.2a.6 / D.2b collapses to one `action` value. The orchestrator executes the directive verbatim. `unknown_state` is the escape hatch — the orchestrator pauses and returns to the user instead of guessing.

Compatibility window (TASK-001 PHASE_D_STATE_MACHINE_COMPLETION): the optional `args.reviewer` field is emitted on the explicit skip-review path (input `reviewer:"none"`) so the follow-on `commit-task` invocation can pass `--reviewer none`. Other paths omit `args.reviewer` for backward compatibility.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation. Always present on `unknown_state`; optional otherwise.

args.description: Action-specific arguments. Fields not relevant to the action MAY be absent.

reviewer.description: Reviewer identity round-tripped onto the directive. Currently emitted only on the skip-review path (input `reviewer:"none"`) so the orchestrator can call `commit-task --reviewer none` without re-deriving it.

commit_flags.description: Flag composition for `plan_ops.py commit-task`. Respects argparse XOR constraints: narrow_remediation_tag XOR remediation_tag; dismissed_finding_ids requires narrow_remediation_tag; narrow_remediation_tag requires non-empty dismissed_finding_ids.

policy_kind.description: Machine-readable fail/pause family. Lets the orchestrator distinguish binding-policy decisions from D.4 fail/rescue and D.2b role-swap terminal failures without inspecting prose.

unattended_revert_policy.description: The unattended revert policy that selected the binding branch behavior.

authorization_source.description: Machine-readable authorization for follow-on fail-task paths when the route emits `fail`.

pause_payload.description: Payload for the `awaiting_user` log event. `stage` enumerates the canonical pause points.

dispatch_context.description: Context for re-dispatch templates (PhaseB-rework / PhaseB-narrow-remediation / PhaseD5).
